subject: Re: HIPI status: decision - demo scopes to goal-reaching + discrete rewards
body:
All,

Decision, so we stop re-litigating this in standups: the May 14 internal demo covers goal-reaching and discrete-reward-set results only. Linear reward families move to a stretch appendix - Nikhil's cheaper estimator got the sample cost down to ~1.8x budget, which is progress but not demo-grade.

What we show: the 71% vs 58% goal-reaching result, plus discrete-reward acceleration on 7 of 9 configs. Framing for leadership is the data-flywheel story from kickoff - relabeling with inverse RL lets one buffer serve many tasks.

For Q3 OKR planning I'll propose 'HIPI relabeling available as a library for two partner agent teams' as the follow-on. Bruno, please sanity-check the staffing implication before I submit.

Nice work getting here inside the window.

Ulla
